notes.title: Press Release Gravity Wars
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33757933/93d5d9b172d8c06a81ba8fa056e16222a9c42b2f.png

Discover Gravity Wars and test your reflexes in a difficult arcade game in the days of yore

The long-awaited day has finally arrived. The very first game of the Black Potion studio is available on Steam. The confrontation with your friends awaits you in this arcade game whose difficulty exceeds understanding.

Gravity Wars is an 90s arcade game. Try to survive in the chaos of this hardcore geometric battleground, customize entirely the scenario you want with up to 12 arenas available, and see which of you or your friends can survive the longest.

You will need reflexes and focus to avoid every particles displayed in the screen. Other players will try to kill you by any means to be the last one standing.

Key Features


 Playable Up to 4 Players
 Access to 2 superpowers : a turbo and a shockwave
 12 arenas available
 Customize entirely your game
 Amazing music made by Réno
 Full Controller Support


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33757933/458092ead5970432be3d4ba8423ad29423552321.png

Title : Gravity Wars
Develop by : Black Potion
Genre : Hardcore, Arcade, Retro, Action
Available on: PC, Mac and Linux
Steam Release: 15th November 2018
Price : 4.99$
Platform : Steam and Itch.io

Steam review codes are now available! To request code, please fill out the request form, found here: https://goo.gl/forms/H4ZQ0fFftHdXgyyf2
We’d appreciate if you’d share this news with your audience! Social media shoutouts including @BlackPotionHQ and #GravityWars are also greatly appreciated!


About Black Potion

Black Potion is a French indie video game studio founded in April 2018 by 2 passionates about the video game world. With already 2 mobile games and 2 PC games, this small studio has the crazy mission to innovate and transmit the passion of video games to current and future generations.
